about_text: I-CARe Auctions inemiphefumulo emibili. Eyokuqala iwuhlu lwewebhu (iportal): ihlanganisa endaweni eyodwa zonke izindali zezakhiwo ezivela ezinkantolo zase-Italy — izindlu, amavila, amafulethi — zihlala zivulekile ukuze uzihlole. ps_sections: What you buy

By signing up you join the CARe Auctions HUB and use the services of your plan: auctions, iCARe, valuations, multilingual chat, iShop, iDream and everything your plan includes. Services start when you pay.
How much you pay and when
You pay the fee of the plan you chose (VAT included where applicable) when you subscribe and then every month, on the same day. If the price changes, we tell you by email at least 30 days in advance.
Renewal and cancellation

The subscription renews automatically every month. You can cancel whenever you like, in one click, from your personal area: cancellation applies from the next cycle, with no penalties and no questions.
3bis
12-month plans
If you choose a 12-month plan (iCARe, iShop or iPartner), you commit for 12 months: you pay the plan fee every month for 12 months, as we show you before payment.
Transaction fees
On iShop purchases and on the transactions included in your plan, a 1% fee applies, capped at €19.90, always shown before you pay.
4bis
Imali yokuphumelela (kuphela uma uwina indlu)

Uma iCARe kanye nethimba lethu likuhola ekunqobeni indawo yokuhlala endalini yezindlu, ukhokha inhlawulo yempumelelo yesilinganiso esitholakalayo ngentengo yokunqoba, ngokusho kwethebula elingezansi: iphesenti lesigaba sisebenza kuyo yonke intengo, ngaphansi kwesamba esincane esingu-{min} (ngaphandle kwe-VAT). Ikhokhwa kuphela uma umphumela usufinyelelwe, kungakapheli amahora angu-{h} kusukela ekunqobeni.
iDream (always optional)
In every payment, as the last item, you can donate to iDream any amount you like, even 1 cent. If you don't turn it on, you donate nothing. 20% of revenue goes to good causes in any case.
Your data
Your data stays yours. We use it only to provide the services, with the highest security, as explained in the Privacy Notice. Never passed to third parties for advertising.
Our commitments
We answer, we help, and iCARe stands by your side. If something isn't right, write to us: info@careauctions.co. We fix it before anything else.
The law
For everything else, Italian law and the court of Cagliari apply. The full clauses are in the Terms and Conditions, which you accept together with this Pact.

wl_consent: Ngiyavuma ukuthi kusetshenzwe imininingwane nemibhalo yami, kuhlanganise nemininingwane yezempilo, ngenhloso yohlu lokulinda lwe-iDream kuphela. Ibonwa nguMsunguli kuphela.

bn_sub: Izindlu nezakhiwo ezishicilelwe ngamalungu e-CARe, ezinezithombe namavidiyo. Uhlu ngalunye luhlolwa uMsunguli ngaphambi kokuba lushicilelwe.

rl_draft: Uhlaka: le mithetho iba ngeyokugcina kuphela ngemva kokuba uMsunguli eqinisekisile nokuba kusayinwe isivumelwano somthetho semalimboleko yokusebenzisa ngaphandle kwenkokhelo (comodato d'uso gratuito) esihambisana nomthetho wezwe.
rl_edit_hint: Umbhalo ohleliwe ungena esikhundleni sohlelo olusalungiswa olimini lwamanje kuphela.
rl_1_d: Noma yimuphi umuntu omdala, kunoma yiliphi izwe, ongenayo indlu efanele ngenxa yezinkinga zezomnotho noma zomzimba. Ukubhalisa kudinga i-akhawunti ye-CARe.
rl_2_d: Amadokhumende abonisa ubunzima ayadingeka. UMsunguli kuphela uwabona futhi angase acele amanye; izitatimende ezingelona iqiniso ziholela ekukhishweni.
rl_3_d: Amakhaya athengwa kuphela ngeminikelo ye-iDream futhi ahlala engewohlelo.
rl_4_d: Sicubungula ubunzima benkinga, abantwana, abantu abanokukhubazeka noma abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-65 ekhaya, usuku lokubhalisa nendlela ikhaya elitholakala ngayo eduze nendawo ekhonjisiwe.
rl_5_t: Imali mboleko yokusebenzisa mahhala (comodato d'uso gratuito)
rl_5_d: Noma ngubani owamukela ikhaya akakhokhi irenti: kuphela izinsiza nokulungiswa okuncane, futhi akavunyelwe ukuyiqashisa, ukuyithengisa noma ukuyidlulisela.
rl_6_d: Inkontileka inesikhathi esibhaliwe, esivuselelekayo, nokubuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile kwesimo.
rl_7_d: Kuphela ngenxa yokusebenzisa ngokungafanele, izitatimende ezingelona iqiniso noma lapho ubunzima buphela, nesaziso esifanele.
rl_8_d: Sishicilela izibalo zabantu ababhalisiwe, abaqinisekisiwe kanye namakhaya abelwe, ngaphandle kwemininingwane yomuntu siqu. Imithetho ingase ibuyekezwe: inguqulo eshicilelwe isebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi.

pa_how1_d: Umuthengisi ufaka imininingwane, izithombe namavidiyo; iCARe ibhala uhlu. Umsunguli uyalubuyekeza ngaphambi kokuba luye ngaphandle.
pa_how2_d: iCARe Valuation ibala ububanzi benani: eliphezulu kakhulu intengo yesisekelo, eliphansi kakhulu isibheselo esincane.
pa_how3_d: Umdayisi ukhetha indlela: ama-iAuctions wezinsuku ezi-7, 14, 21 noma 28, noma i-Buy It Now ngentengo ebekiwe. Is teklifu emizuzwini emi-2 yokugcina yelulisa ukuthengiswa kwendlu ngezinye izikhathi ezi-2.

pa_how5_d: Ekupheleni incwadi yomthetho yezindlu nemihlaba (indayo yezakhiwo) iwina okungenani ephakeme, uma okungenani ilingana nokungenani okuncane. Nge-Intengo Yokuthenga Ngokushesha iwina lowo oqinisekisa kuqala.
pa_how6_d: Umthengisi nomthengi bakhokha imali yensizakalo yokuphumelela ku-inthanethi futhi baqedele ukuthengiselana kwendawo ngommeli womthetho.
